name: Lu Weijun
source: Juno is insensitive and belligerent. She looks like a hot-headed warmonger. Yet she is unrivalled in her knowledge of modern army. According to herself, joining the Revelation Society was only her way of using her knowledge without any reservation because one day, she will make the pacifists in Craftsman Union see what she is really capable of.
